column1: # Live airdefenders multiplayer topic → .proto file → message name manifest.
# Consumed by build-fds.sh + upload-all.sh + the bootstrap-airdefenders-portal.sh
# final stage. Tab-separated. Columns:
#   topic_key_pattern
# wire_format is `json` for every row in this iteration — the airdefenders
# Go publisher emits JSON on the wire (envelope.payload is a JSON object)
# even though the schema body the portal stores is protobuf-fds AND the
# topic.format is PATCH'd to `protobuf:<MsgName>`. The portal's
# data-dictionary viewer renders the .fds; the inspector's "decode samples"
# path will protobuf-decode the JSON bytes and fail per-sample. Same gap
# the synth-vendor schemas live with — see CLAUDE.md §"Notional collapse"
# wire-format-gap call-out. Flipping the wire format is a future task.
# SITE_ID is substituted at portal-registration time by
# bootstrap-airdefenders-portal.sh; the key_pattern column here uses the
# literal `<SITE>` placeholder that the bootstrap script replaces with
# ${SITE_ID:-nova} when it looks up topic ids. build-fds.sh and
# upload-all.sh don't care about the key_pattern column directly; they
# match topic-id by proto_file → portal lookup.
airdefenders/<SITE>/radar/detection/v1
airdefenders/<SITE>/missile/fired/v1
airdefenders/<SITE>/missile/intercept/v1
airdefenders/<SITE>/shahed/impact/v1
